# Clairen Haus

> Clairen Haus is an operations consultancy. It works one-on-one with small businesses on recurring operational problems, and offers AI implementation, consultation-led SaaS development (including the Signature Delivery Suite™) and digital services (website creation, AEO / AI visibility).

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.clairenhaus.com/): Operations consulting, AI implementation, SaaS development, digital services, and contact.
- [About](https://www.clairenhaus.com/about): About Clairen Haus.
- [Portfolio](https://www.clairenhaus.com/portfolio): Community platforms, client portals, client delivery software and AI agent demos built by Clairen Haus.
- [Case study: Sistahz In Systems](https://www.clairenhaus.com/case-studies/sistahz-in-systems): Designed, built and launched by Michelle: a private members’ community platform.
- [Case study: Clairen Haus Client Portal](https://www.clairenhaus.com/case-studies/client-portal): A private portal where website clients follow their build from deposit to launch.
- [Case study: Signature Delivery Suite](https://www.clairenhaus.com/case-studies/signature-delivery-suite): Client delivery software for executive and leadership coaches.

- [Privacy policy](https://www.clairenhaus.com/privacy-policy): How the site handles personal information.
